dataset.name: LRO MOON LROC 2 EDR V1.0
dataset.terse: Un-calibrated data from Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC).
dataset.abstract: This data set comprises Un-calibrated data from the LROC NAC and WAC cameras. The science data is comprised of Un-calibrated raw images, along with pointing data and housekeeping information.
dataset.citation: Robinson, M., LRO MOON LROC 2 EDR V1.0, LRO-L-LROC-2-EDR-V1.0, NASA Planetary Data System (PDS), 2009.
